question: Does matching teacher logit differences improve AUC recovery compared with the existing absolute-logit refinement?
changed_setting: Use mean squared centered student-minus-teacher residual within the actual batch, equivalent to mean pairwise logit-difference error up to a constant.
interpretation: Teacher score-difference surrogate, not label-based AUC optimization. Equal-history-length buckets constrain within-batch offsets; global AUC improvement is not guaranteed.
